title: Great Are the Works of the Lord

questions.question: Praise the Lord! I will give thanks to the Lord with my whole what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 111:1 (ESV): "Praise the Lord! I will give thanks to the Lord with my whole heart,"

questions.question: Great are the works of the Lord, studied by all who delight in whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 111:2 (ESV): "Great are the works of the Lord, studied by all who delight in them."

questions.question: Full of splendor and majesty is his work, and his righteousness endures how long?
He has caused his wondrous works to be remembered; the Lord is gracious and what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 111:4 (ESV): "...the Lord is gracious and merciful."

questions.question: He provides food for those who fear him; he remembers his covenant how long?
He has shown his people the power of his works, in giving them the inheritance of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 111:6 (ESV): "...in giving them the inheritance of the nations."

questions.question: The works of his hands are faithful and just; all his precepts are what?
They are established forever and ever, to be performed with faithfulness and what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 111:8 (ESV): "...to be performed with faithfulness and uprightness."

questions.question: He sent redemption to his people; he has commanded his covenant forever. Holy and awesome is his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 111:9 (ESV): "...Holy and awesome is his name!"

questions.question: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 111:10 (ESV): "The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom;"

questions.question: All those who practice it have a good what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 111:10 (ESV): "...all those who practice it have a good understanding."

questions.question: This Psalm is an acrostic poem, meaning each line begins with a successive letter of what?
questions.explanation: Like Psalm 112 and 119, it is an acrostic.

questions.question: Who delights in the works of the Lord?
questions.explanation: Psalm 111:2 (ESV): "...studied by all who delight in them."

key_verse_text: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom; all those who practice it have a good understanding. His praise endures forever!
